meta.title: Pricing — Mobilcab
meta.description: Pricing in RON, no contract: a free plan, Basic from 49 RON/month, and plans with the AI assistant from 99 RON/month. Cancel anytime.

hero.label: Pricing
hero.title: Pricing in RON. No contract, no thousands of euros upfront.
hero.body: Start free and move to a paid plan only when you need it. What changes between plans is the AI assistant: how often you can use it.

callout.title: New here?
callout.body: Founding Partner pricing locks the Basic plan at 549 RON/year, for 12 months. Only for the first 100 workshops.

fpYearly: Founding Partner: {price} RON/year, locked for 12 months
aiTrial: AI assistant: one trial, during onboarding

free.name: Free
free.for: To try Mobilcab on your own projects, with no risk at all.

basic.name: Basic
basic.for: For carpenters who want design, cutlists and CNC export, without AI.

starter.name: Starter
starter.for: For workshops that want the AI assistant on everyday projects.
features: The AI assistant checks and suggests

pro.name: Pro
pro.for: For workshops with many projects a month.
features: Three times as many AI requests

studio.name: Studio
studio.for: For workshops that use the AI assistant on every project.

why.title: Why is AI only in the bigger plans?
why.body: Every request to the AI assistant costs us, so plans with AI cost more. Basic doesn't use AI, which is why it can stay this affordable. So you know what you're getting or missing, everyone tries the assistant once, during onboarding.

note: Final prices are confirmed before launch.
